sc-us-shortlist.removedWhen: ids becomes empty (key is removed, not written as empty)

shape.ids: string[] vendor ids, insertion order = column order a,b,c,d; max 4 honoured
shape.weights: {} legacy; always written as {} by new saves; any stored value is ignored
shape.at: number, Date.now() ms of last change

readTolerance: ids deduped, non-strings dropped, sliced to 4
unknown vendor ids and vendors not in the category dropped at render time
factual or unknown category => treated as empty
at more than 60 s in the future => empty (workspaceSavedSelection only)
age >= 180 days => empty (stored value is NOT deleted until next write)
stale plan id => falls back to product-wide evidence + notice

cookies: none set by first-party code on these pages

/compare/.plan_a|plan_b|plan_c|plan_d: researched plan id for that slot (omit or empty = product-wide)
